source.upstream: references/styles/01_通用母版/质感专业/数据新闻编辑风.md

visual_language.direction: Bloomberg-Economist news infographic deck, dense multi-column grid with inline micro-charts and data tables, editorial sidebars and pull-stats, hairline dividers, hero numbers, running source lines, cool restrained publication field, flat print-grade

content_review.reviewer_note: 结构完整（负面约束+密度映射在案）：候选晋升，需 U3 语义审阅补主题绑定与特征后转 active

legacy_payload.best_for: 以多栏网格内联微图表、编辑侧栏、pull-stat 与常驻来源行的出版级密度,做财经/研报/年度数据报告的新闻信息图阅读感;适合市场复盘、行业数据密集汇报、data-driven 解释长文
legacy_payload.visual_direction: Bloomberg-Economist news infographic deck, dense multi-column grid with inline micro-charts and data tables, editorial sidebars and pull-stats, hairline dividers, hero numbers, running source lines, cool restrained publication field, flat print-grade

canvas.background: 冷出版纸白 #F8F9FA(浅场,Economist 版;深场可换石墨终端底,行为不变)
canvas.composition: 多栏网格承载大量小图与数据表,密度即外观;侧栏 + pull-stat + 源行常驻
canvas.density: high,紧而有序——网格挣得密度不挣得杂乱

color_palette.secondary: #1E3A5F(深蓝墨:标题/表格线/图表主系列)
color_palette.rule: 图表系列只用同族 tints 不用彩虹;数字颜色表义(涨/跌/风险/焦点)不装饰;强调色 <10% 只标风险与关键数字

typography.title: 衬线大标题/hero 数字(思源宋体 / Georgia 系),权威出版气质
typography.body: 无衬线正文(Inter / 思源黑体),表格与图表标签可用等宽(JetBrains Mono / IBM Plex Mono)保数字精度
typography.labels: 小图注 + 紧来源行,小字号克制层级

layout_patterns: 每页 = 结论句标题 + 满版多栏网格(2-4 栏),栏内嵌微图表/数据表,发丝线 #1E3A5F 分栏
pull-stat 侧栏:一栏窄侧栏放 hero 数字(3-5x 正文)+ 一行结论
源行常驻:页脚小字数据来源与截止日期,每图必有
market map 页:logo/文字占位格 Grid 满版 + 单色阶梯高亮焦点格
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: 信息密度即外观,但每页只有一个结论句标题;网格之外零装饰,图表即视觉
negative_prompt: no rainbow chart palettes — series colors stay in one family's tints
no decorative glow, shadows or heavy cards; hairline rules carry structure
no keynote-style hero whitespace; density is the look
colors never decorate — a colored number must mean up/down/risk/focus
legacy_payload.palette_family: 浅场 cool-corporate(克制蓝金)/ 深场 dark-cinematic(Bloomberg 终端);源规格颜色行为分离——HEX 由品牌侧替换,本风格只锁用色纪律

visual_elements.allowed: 内联微图表,数据表,编辑侧栏,发丝分隔线,hero 数字,来源行
visual_elements.avoid: 装饰性大图;重卡片阴影;彩虹系列色;无源数据图

rendering_constraints: Publication-grade flat: hairline rules over heavy cards; optional scrim on images.
Every chart carries a source line; numbers are colored to mean.

recommendation_features.feature_defaults_basis: family-prior (U3)：机械默认按家族语义先验替换，来源记录在案

negative: Publication-grade flat: hairline rules over heavy cards; optional scrim on images.
Every chart carries a source line; numbers are colored to mean.
